no-restricted-properties.message: String.prototype.normalize() is not implemented by Hermes (React Native) without the Intl variant — it is undefined at runtime and crashes on Android even though web typecheck/lint/tests pass (LS-7946). This package is native-reachable. Strip diacritics with a Hermes-safe precomposed-character map instead of String.prototype.normalize. To add another Hermes-incompatible API to this guard, extend the shared .eslintrc.hermes.json config (LS-7947).
Please use import() instead. More info: https://facebook.github.io/create-react-app/docs/code-splitting
